page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the enhanced ecs.g9it instance family. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or dedicated hardware GPU accelerators. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Persistent storage requires network-attached block storage volumes to support stateful application demands.

The 1:4 compute-to-memory configuration delivers standard resource density suitable for versatile mid-tier enterprise deployments. Workloads compatible with this profile include relational database backends, application middleware, microservices hosting, container clusters, continuous integration workers, and general web serving.
